logp.method_description: The logPo/w values of the Pt(IV) compounds were determined using the shake flask method [46]. The respective Pt(IV) complex was dissolved in 0.9 % NaCl (w/v) ultrapure water presaturated with n-octanol. The solutions were sonicated and filtered to remove undissolved Pt complex. After determining the initial Pt concentrations by ICP-MS the solutions were added to an equal volume of n-octanol presaturated with 0.9 % NaCl (w/v) ultrapure water. The heterogeneous mixtures were shaken vigorously for 30 min and centrifuged at 4000 rpm for 30 min. The aqueous phase was separated, and the Pt concentration was measured again by ICP-MS. The logPo/w values were calculated as the logarithms of the ratios of the concentrations of Pt in the organic and aqueous phase. All experiments were carried out in duplicate.
